title: Regional EMU with a loud cab
why: Below 250 km/h the cab limit at maximum speed is 78 dB.

spec.name: Regional EMU with a loud cab

noise.cab_standstill_horn_db.rationale: Noise TSI 4.2.4 Table 5 (cab, for units fitted with a cab: standstill with horns 95 dB; at vmax 78 dB if vmax < 250 km/h, 80 dB if 250 ≤ vmax < 350 km/h): 96 > 95.

noise.cab_max_speed_db.rationale: Noise TSI 4.2.4 Table 5 (cab, for units fitted with a cab: standstill with horns 95 dB; at vmax 78 dB if vmax < 250 km/h, 80 dB if 250 ≤ vmax < 350 km/h): 200 < 250, so 78 dB; 79 > 78.
